name: Tapestry
description: A four-cell rosette woven out of quarter-arcs.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0% 0%, #000 0 46%, transparent 46% 68%, #000 68%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0% 0%, #000 0 46%, transparent 46% 68%, #000 68%); -webkit-transform: scale(1, 1); transform: scale(1, 1); @match(@x % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, 1); transform: scale(-1, 1); } @match(@y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(1, -1); transform: scale(1, -1); } @match(@x % 2 + @y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, -1); transform: scale(-1, -1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
